property_summary: For any caller who is the owner and any positive amount, calling sendTo should attempt to transfer exactly the requested amount (so the call reverts when C lacks sufficient balance); the mutant that always transfers 0 breaks this because it will succeed when the original would revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer with a zero-value transfer which may succeed even when original would revert due to insufficient balance (if amount > 0), changing revert behavior.
